records.source_observation: Cambridge describes a difficult-to-understand adjective, marked formal; no CEFR label visible in publisher-indexed excerpt.
records.editorial_risk: Cambridge meaning is compatible with the draft; neither the index nor a generic advanced-register label establishes C1. Independently verify source-specific C1 classification or replace.
records.myanmar_review_prompt: Review whether 'အယူအဆများ အလွန်ရှုပ်ထွေး၍' unnecessarily restricts abstruse to ideas; original example grammar and teaching suitability require external signoff.
records.shortlist_english_definition: Difficult to understand because the ideas are unusually complex.
records.shortlist_myanmar_meaning: အယူအဆများ အလွန်ရှုပ်ထွေး၍ နားလည်ရခက်သော
records.shortlist_example: The lecturer explained the abstruse theory with a simple diagram.

records.source_observation: Cambridge marks an intransitive formal verb for deliberately unclear speech, often to conceal truth; no CEFR label visible.
records.editorial_risk: Draft defines evasion of a direct answer but omits the possible concealment-of-truth nuance. Verify grammar of 'began to equivocate' and source-backed C1 label.
records.myanmar_review_prompt: Review Myanmar 'တိုက်ရိုက်အဖြေမပေးလိုသဖြင့်' as an overly narrow motive; distinguish equivocating from simply being uncertain.
records.shortlist_english_definition: To speak unclearly in order to avoid giving a direct answer.
records.shortlist_myanmar_meaning: တိုက်ရိုက်အဖြေမပေးလိုသဖြင့် မရှင်းမလင်း လှည့်ပတ်ပြောဆိုသည်
records.shortlist_example: The witness began to equivocate when asked about the missing documents.

records.source_observation: Cambridge formal sense covers making an issue harder to understand, often intentionally; also separately lists online-data and source-code senses; no CEFR label visible.
records.editorial_risk: Draft definition asserts deliberate action while example 'jargon can obfuscate' does not imply intent; align exact sense, agency and example before approval.
records.myanmar_review_prompt: Review whether 'ရည်ရွယ်ချက်ရှိရှိ' misrepresents accidental obscurity in example; do not conflate technical obfuscation with general unclear communication.
records.shortlist_english_definition: To make information deliberately difficult to understand.
records.shortlist_myanmar_meaning: သတင်းအချက်အလက်ကို ရည်ရွယ်ချက်ရှိရှိ နားလည်ရခက်အောင် ရှုပ်ထွေးစေသည်
records.shortlist_example: Technical jargon can obfuscate the real reasons for a delay.

records.source_observation: Cambridge marks an uncountable formal noun for sustained courage when facing difficulty; no CEFR label visible.
records.editorial_risk: Draft adds patience; review whether patience is a necessary component of the sense. Original example is plausible but not independently checked.
records.myanmar_review_prompt: Myanmar gloss 'သတ္တိနှင့် ခံနိုင်ရည်' may be reasonable; confirm natural wording and distinction from mere endurance.
records.shortlist_english_definition: Courage and patience when facing pain or serious difficulty.
records.shortlist_myanmar_meaning: နာကျင်မှု သို့မဟုတ် ပြင်းထန်သော အခက်အခဲကို ရင်ဆိုင်ရာတွင် ရှိသော သတ္တိနှင့် ခံနိုင်ရည်
records.shortlist_example: The family showed great fortitude during the long recovery.

records.source_observation: Cambridge marks an uncountable formal noun combining readiness or eagerness with quick action; no CEFR label visible.
records.editorial_risk: Draft adds cheerfulness; review whether this extra emotional quality is necessary and whether 'responded with alacrity' is idiomatic.
records.myanmar_review_prompt: Myanmar gloss includes 'ပျော်ရွှင်စွာ' which may overstate happiness; independently assess willingness and speed without overtranslation.
records.shortlist_english_definition: Cheerful willingness and speed in doing something.
records.shortlist_myanmar_meaning: အလုပ်တစ်ခုကို စိတ်အားထက်သန်ပျော်ရွှင်စွာနှင့် လျင်မြန်စွာ ဆောင်ရွက်လိုစိတ်
records.shortlist_example: The volunteers responded with alacrity when help was requested.

records.source_observation: Cambridge marks an uncountable formal noun for relevance or importance to the matter under discussion; no CEFR label visible.
records.editorial_risk: Draft blends noticeable prominence with importance. Distinguish discourse relevance from perceptual salience; verify 'salience of safety concerns' collocation.
records.myanmar_review_prompt: Myanmar 'အထူးထင်ရှားပြီး အရေးပါနေမှု' may conflate prominence and relevance; check against chosen publisher sense.
records.shortlist_english_definition: The quality of being especially noticeable or important in a particular situation.
records.shortlist_myanmar_meaning: အခြေအနေတစ်ခုတွင် အထူးထင်ရှားပြီး အရေးပါနေမှု
records.shortlist_example: The salience of safety concerns increased after the accident.
